title: Can Students Get SASSA Grants?
description: Find out if tertiary or secondary school students are eligible for SASSA social grants. Rules for NSFAS recipients, TVET college students, and part-time learners.

seo.metaTitle: Can Students Get SASSA Grants? Student Eligibility Guide
seo.metaDescription: Complete guide to SASSA grant eligibility for students. Learn if tertiary and secondary students qualify, how NSFAS affects eligibility, and what to do after your studies end.

contentBlocks.text: Students in South Africa often struggle with living costs. However, social grant eligibility for students depends strictly on whether you receive other state funding.

checklist: Must be enrolled in a school or tertiary institution
Must not receive NSFAS or other government bursaries
Must meet the basic age and income requirements
restrictions: Active NSFAS recipients are completely excluded from receiving the SRD R370 grant

steps.title: Get proof of non-funding
steps.description: Ensure you have a letter or document proving you do not receive NSFAS funding.

steps.title: Apply for your grant
steps.description: Apply online or at a SASSA branch with your academic proof and ID.

faqs.question: Can I get a grant if I am studying at a TVET college?
faqs.answer: Yes, provided you do NOT receive any NSFAS allowance, transport bursary, or accommodation funding.

faqs.question: I finished my studies but SASSA says I am still NSFAS funded. What do I do?
faqs.answer: Upload your graduation certificate or academic transcript along with a NSFAS completion letter to trigger the database update.
